nom: Avène Hydrance Light Hydrating Emulsion, Oily Skin, 1.3 oz

avis.titre: Good for combo skin. Scented.Good for combo skin. Scented.
avis.texte: This moisturizer has a lightweight texture. It reminds me of a gel-cream. It does have a floral/powdery/fresh scent. It doesn’t bother me that much but a lot of people don’t like scented face products. I took off one star for the fact that it’s scented because I feel it’s unnecessary. Especially since this moisturizer is labeled for sensitive skin. I also feel like it is pricey for the small 1.3 floz bottle. It seems a bit basic for $40 doesn’t it? I have combo/acne prone skin and I am currently on prescription tretinoin/hydroquinone cream from my dermatologist. I needed a face moisturizer that is light and wouldn’t clog my pores but also super hydrating. My skin is very sensitive right now and I had no issues with this moisturizer. I felt it provided the perfect amount of hydration without being greasy and heavy feeling on my face. I don’t like heavy moisturizers. The hydrance rich version is way too heavy for me. The finish of this light moisturizer is soft and doesn’t leave a sticky feeling, like some face moisturizers do. I can wear this year round. It is hard to find the perfect balance of hydration without being greasy. Overall I will keep purchasing it because I am extremely picky about the texture of my face moisturizers and this one is perfect for me. It also wears well under sunscreen and makeup. I do think it’s a little overpriced and the fragrance is unnecessary. Overall it works for me but it’s very important to know about the floral fragrance. The fragrance does

I have very sensitive skin and tend to get oily in the summer, so I was looking for something lightweight and this delivered! It has a mild scent and feels great on my skin. It also keeps my skin moisturized without causing any irritation or breakouts.

This is a light face lotion which is smooth and penetrates the skin nicely. There is another product by the same company that looks exactly the same except it does not say LIGHT. I have that product too and for me, that is too heavy and lays on the skin - I feel like I have something on my face. This line is pricey but my dermatologist recommended this and overall I like the entire product line.

Avene has been a well known brand all around Europe, Australia and Asia; easily accessible from most Chemists. We haven't tried their products before as I had the habit of picking skincare based on my friends' recommendations and Avene was not in their radar. From our last trip overseas, I decided to pick this up to try and immediately fell in love with it! It is non greasy yet very effective in dry months. Price point is also reasonable and I have re-ordered on Amazon since! Highly recommend it.

Strong perfume scent that triggered my allergies. Why would a product designed for sensitive skin have fragrance added? My dermatologist had provided me some samples from Avene that were unscented and worked great, but this product is unusable for me if it's perfumed.
Have ordered 3 times now, great product and does what it says. Love the scent as well. Great under makeup, non greasy.
Llevo más de 5 años utilizando siempre esta crema Me súper hidrata y es amable con mi piel Me encanta!

Tengo 35 años, toda mi vida he sufrido de piel sensible y mi piel no es fácil de humectar, esta crema ha sido sin duda de mis mejores descubrimientos, con esta crema he quedado fascinada con los resultados.

Ich benutze die Creme seit Jahren gegen trockene, rissige Stellen und partieller Neurodermitis. Die Creme zeigt, bei regelmäßiger Anwendung sehr schnell ihre Wirkung. Von der Neurodermitis merke ich seit Jahren nichts mehr, solange ich regelmäßig eincreme, und auch trockene rissige Lippen zu dieser Jahreszeit sind in Rekordzeit wieder heile. Ich benutze sie auch als Creme nach der Gesichtsrasur und sie lindert sehr schnell die Reizungen. Auch nach einer OP habe ich mir danach die Narbe täglich eingecremt und damit massiert und sie ist schön glatt geworden :) Nicht ganz billig, aber die Wirkung spricht für sich. Bei täglichem Eincremen (1x abends) reicht 1 Tube etwa 1,5 - 2 Monate bei mir.
Hands down my favourite moisturizer, such a light, refreshing feeling when applied!

Llevo 7 años usando esta crema y solo puedo decir que estoy muy contento con ella. Es una crema que hidrata bien y al cabo de 10 segundos ha absorbido toda y no deja rastros de grasa en la piel. La recomiendo totalmente.
Esta marca me encanta muchos de mis productos de Skincare son de ella, pero esta crema me encanta es la única q uso en mi piel sensible y no me deja grasa ni me irrita
I was sent an item that expired in 2024!!! The product is already expensive enough for you to send me an item that expired almost two years ago.
Avene hydrating facial moisturizer was ordered 2/11/2026. Order was delivered on 2/12/2026. Item was stamped expired 10/2025 on the tube and on the box. I returned the item.

avis.texte: Product received in September 2025: Expiration date on the packaging is 06 23! And now, there is no place to ask for a refund, bc the window has passed. Really?
Check expiration upon receiving. Received product that expired July 2025 and it’s October 2025.
Horrible! Received an expired product!! 09/22 marked on the packaging and the product itself.
Unacceptable to sell in 2025 a cream from 2019 with the expiration date 09/2022!
